tasks.label: Piで再通知を手動検証
args: set -e; cd /home/pi/work/wifi-client-notifier; sudo systemctl stop wifi-notifier; cp config/wifi_notifier_state.json config/wifi_notifier_state.json.manual-test.bak; trap 'cp config/wifi_notifier_state.json.manual-test.bak config/wifi_notifier_state.json; sudo systemctl start wifi-notifier' EXIT; /home/pi/work/wifi-client-notifier/.venv/bin/python3 -c 'import json,time; p="config/wifi_notifier_state.json"; m="1e:b0:33:40:05:71"; s=json.load(open(p,encoding="utf-8")); s["known_devices"]=[x for x in s.get("known_devices",[]) if x.lower()!=m]; s.setdefault("missing_counts",{}).pop(m,None); s.setdefault("disconnected_at",{})[m]=time.time()-7200; json.dump(s,open(p,"w",encoding="utf-8"),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)'; /home/pi/work/wifi-client-notifier/.venv/bin/python3 src/wifi_notifier.py config/config.yaml --single-run
